chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from some of his companions, from Mismā‘, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, from Amir al-Mu'minin, may the blessings of Allah be upon him.
That he forbade a man from entering the water except with a waist-wrapper.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; the legal subject addressed in the report
key_terms.الْمَاءَ: the water; referring to water for bathing or immersion
key_terms.بِمِئْزَرٍ: with a waist-wrapper; a garment used to cover the private area
key_terms.نَهَى: he forbade; indicates prohibition or disapproval in the legal context
key_terms.يَدْخُلَ: to enter; here, entering the water

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to enter water without wearing a covering in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام a prohibition against a man entering the water without a covering. It indicates an etiquette and legal norm of preserving modesty while bathing or entering water.
